text:
Vik: onboarding sampleapp blocked on secrets step. Node SDK call returns 404 but curl is fine. Anyone seen this pattern?
Marta: ugh. paste the curl + SDK snippet?
Vik: curl that works:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/secrets?projectId=p-9&env=prod\"
```
Vik: Node SDK (failing):
```js
await client.admin.getSecrets({ projectId: 'p-9', env: 'prod' })
// Error: 404 Not Found: route not found
```
Ken: do we even expose getSecrets in the SDK? Codegen sometimes renames list/get verbs.
Vik: The generated client actually has `secrets.list` and `secrets.get_secret` methods. `secrets.list` calls `/v1/admin/secrets/list` (404). The REST API is `/v1/admin/secrets` (no verb).
Priya: so codegen renamed a plain collection route into a verbful path. That's a parity/regression. We changed the codegen naming rules in the spec->sdk mapping last sprint and missed a few collection routes.
Marta: also can you capture the outgoing URL from the SDK?
Vik: grabbed HAR from the onboarding container. SDK sent: `/v1/admin/secrets?PROJECTID=p-9&ENV=PROD` (all caps). The curl used camelCase `projectId=p-9&env=prod`.
Ken: capitalization + naming changes  two separate problems. Why caps? Some of our generators normalize query keys for legacy libs. Looks like a bad mapping function in the Go->JS layer.
Priya: and if the SDK hits `/v1/admin/secrets/list` that's a 404; but even if it hit the right base path the uppercase query keys fail strict param matching on the backend. We tightened param matching last week so `PROJECTID` no longer maps to `projectId`.
Alfie: one more wrinkle I noticed in the logs: auth header is sometimes doubled when using our onboarding token provider. Outbound header: `Authorization: Bearer Bearer abcd...` Backend rejects that intermittently (401) depending on gateway parser.
Vik: I saw that too, but only on retry attempts. First request got 202 from gateway, SDK retried and second attempt had doubled prefix and failed, leaving onboarding in a weird half-state.
Marta: retry + mutated header = nasty race. Is createSecrets idempotent? No, it's not. Retries here can leave partial state.
Priya: action items: (1) Codegen hotfix to preserve collection route names (no extra /list), (2) fix query-key mapping to preserve original casing (projectId/env), (3) auth provider change: do not prepend 'Bearer ' if token already starts with Bearer, (4) mark secrets POST as non-retriable or require explicit idempotency-key.
Ken: short-term workaround for onboarding ops: use raw request with exact URL + header: `client.request('GET','/v1/admin/secrets?projectId=p-9&env=prod', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer '+token } })` or call curl inside container.
Vik: raw request worked for me and the onboarding continued. Confirmed.
sdk-bot: Created issue #4120 - \"js-sdk: collection route renamed to verb, query key casing normalized to uppercase, and auth provider double-prefixing causing onboarding failures\" and attached HAR/logs.
Alfie: I'm opening PRs: one to revert collection naming in codegen, one to fix query param canonicalizer, and one to guard auth provider against double-prefixing. Will add unit + integration tests.
Marta: please add a golden-URL test in SDK CI that asserts generated URL equals expected curl for admin collection routes. Also add an onboarding smoke job that runs minimal secret listing/creation in CI to catch these drifts earlier.
Priya: agree. Also flag support so they can pause affected onboarding jobs until the patches land.
Vik: thanks team  leaving this thread so it's searchable when future onboarding fails the same way. :thumbsup:
